Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.algorithm

Class ArrayObject

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.SceneObject
io.jengacode.eduvideo.algorithm.ArrayObject
public final class ArrayObject extends SceneObject
Array, list, queue or stack. Swaps are reconstructed from immutable initial labels.

Models array/list/queue/stack labels without mutating initial data during playback. Completed swaps rebuild slot contents; active swaps interpolate positions with a curved lift. Overlapping swaps are rejected.
